title: Node activity and background processing
items: Activity now appears above each working node, with separate running, awaiting and attention states.
Opt into automatic project naming in Project Settings. The local model suggests a name after your first file; names you type stay yours.
Maximum and Medium describe every other screenshot. Balanced and Minimal describe each one. All screenshots remain saved and skipped descriptions are labeled.
Uploaded-video screenshots retain more detail, and visual prompts avoid carrying earlier caption mistakes forward.

After your upload is accepted, FUPCJ Server continues video preparation, transcription and visual descriptions while you are away. Results sync when you return, and incomplete inspections retry automatically.
Update FUPCJ Server, then refresh Vision. The server must remain running; Gemini approval and existing processing limits still apply.
